titleText: JTF News: Deutsche Welle, BBC News
mainText: The Ugandan military reports rescuing approximately 200 hostages from ADF militants in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
A Canadian tourist was killed in a shooting at a Mexico archaeological site.
Tim Cook is stepping down as Chief Executive Officer of Apple in September after serving 15 years in the role.
Tim Cook is stepping down as CEO of Apple, with John Ternus taking over the position.
A shooting at Teotihuacan pyramid site in Mexico resulted in one Canadian tourist killed and four others wounded.
